sections.html:
Whipple's Triad

  • Low plasma glucose: DM < 70 mg/dl, Non-DM < 50 or 55 mg/dl
  • Hypoglycemic symptoms
    • Neuroglycopenic: Stupor, Seizure, Hemiparesis
    • Sympathetic: Palpitation, Sweating, SBP, nausea
  • Resolution of symptoms: after plasma glucose ↑

Non-DM → หาสาเหตุ (ดูด้านล่าง) · DM → Drug-induced hypoglycemia

• Critical illness: Renal insufficiency, Hepatic failure, Cardiac failure, Sepsis
  • Medication: Insulin, SU, Glinide · Alcohol · Other: BB, Quinine, indomethacin
  • Endocrine disorder — ดูด้านล่าง
